tolerance_basis: LamaH daily P published to .0001mm and T .001degC; daily rounding accumulation <.0016mm and monthly temp <=.0005degC. Extra tolerance covers numerical float/geometric precision, not source shifts. All checks must pass; no Q-conditioned processing choices.
aggregation: official full-upstream basin polygon intersect official ERA5L cell polygons; original planar projection area weights; hourly tp daily accumulation at next-day 00UTC converted m->mm; instantaneous T mean 00..23 UTC Kelvin->C; sum daily P and average daily T; calendar full-month only
